judul: Perkenalan dan Obrolan Ringan di Kantor
title: Workplace Introductions and Small Talk
ringkas: Memperkenalkan diri dan jabatan, small talk, menyambut tamu
goals: memperkenalkan diri dan **jabatan** di tempat kerja dengan sopan
memakai [[I work as ...]], [[I'm in charge of ...]], [[I'm responsible for ...]], [[I work in the ... department]]
memperkenalkan rekan kerja dan menanggapi perkenalan
memulai, melanjutkan, dan mengakhiri **small talk** dengan sopan
menyambut tamu atau klien dengan ungkapan formal

lesson.text: Kesan pertama di tempat kerja sering terbentuk dari **30 detik pertama**: cara kita menyapa, memperkenalkan diri, dan berbasa-basi. Di unit ini kamu belajar ungkapan yang **sopan, jelas, dan natural** untuk rekan kerja, atasan, dan tamu.

lesson.title: 1. Memperkenalkan diri dan jabatan
table: [[I'm in charge of ... / I'm responsible for ...]]
[[I've just joined / I started last week.]]

lesson.title: Preposisi pada pekerjaan
lesson.text: [[work as]] + jabatan, [[work in]] + divisi/kota, [[work for]] atau [[work at]] + perusahaan, [[work with]] + orang/alat. Contoh: [[I work as a designer in the Marketing team for a big company.]]

lesson.title: 2. Memperkenalkan orang lain
table: [[May I introduce Mr. Adi, our Operations Manager?]]
[[Let me introduce you to Ms. Sari. She's the head of HR.]]
[[This is Tom. He works with me in IT.]]
[[It's a pleasure to meet you.]] / [[Pleased to meet you.]]
[[Nice to meet you.]] / [[Good to meet you too.]]

items.ex: He works in the Finance department.
I'm part of the Sales team.
She is in charge of training.
I joined the company in May.
We have two new hires today.
Our office is on the 5th floor.
The visitor is waiting in reception.

lesson.title: 4. Small talk: topik aman
table: [[It was relaxing, thanks. How about yours?]]
[[Not bad. The traffic was light today.]]
[[It is. I hope it stays sunny.]]
[[Not yet. I'm going in a few minutes.]]
[[Do you have any plans for the holiday?]]

lesson.title: Topik yang sebaiknya dihindari
lesson.text: Hindari topik **gaji, usia, agama, politik, dan masalah pribadi** saat small talk dengan orang yang baru dikenal. Pilih topik netral seperti cuaca, perjalanan, makanan, dan akhir pekan.

lesson.title: 5. Mengakhiri percakapan dengan sopan
table: [[I'm afraid I have to go. I have a meeting at ten.]]
[[Thank you for your time. I look forward to working with you.]]

lesson.title: 6. Formal vs santai
table: [[How are you? / How do you do?]]

lines.en: Good morning, Dina. Welcome to the team. I'm Sari, the head of HR.
lines.id: Selamat pagi, Dina. Selamat datang di tim. Saya Sari, kepala HR.

lines.en: Good morning, Ms. Sari. It's a pleasure to meet you. I'm excited to start.
lines.id: Selamat pagi, Bu Sari. Senang bertemu dengan Anda. Saya antusias memulai.

lines.en: Let me introduce you to Tom. He works in the Finance department, and he will show you around.
lines.id: Izinkan saya memperkenalkan Anda kepada Tom. Ia bekerja di departemen Keuangan dan akan mengantar Anda berkeliling.

lines.en: Nice to meet you, Dina. What will you be in charge of?
lines.id: Senang bertemu denganmu, Dina. Kamu akan bertanggung jawab atas apa?

lines.en: I'll be responsible for customer reports in the Sales team.
lines.id: Saya akan bertanggung jawab atas laporan pelanggan di tim Penjualan.

lines.en: Morning, Dina. How was your weekend?
It was relaxing, thanks. I visited my family. How about yours?
lines.id: Menyenangkan, terima kasih. Aku mengunjungi keluargaku. Kalau kamu?

lines.en: Pretty quiet. I stayed at home and watched a film.
lines.id: Cukup tenang. Aku di rumah dan menonton film.

lines.en: Sounds nice. I'm afraid I have to go now. I have a meeting at nine.
lines.id: Kedengarannya menyenangkan. Sayangnya aku harus pergi. Aku ada rapat pukul sembilan.

lines.en: No problem. Let's catch up again soon.
lines.id: Tidak apa-apa. Mari mengobrol lagi nanti.

lines.en: Good afternoon. You must be Ms. Putri. Welcome to our office.
lines.id: Selamat siang. Anda pasti Ibu Putri. Selamat datang di kantor kami.

lines.en: Good afternoon, Mr. Adi. Thank you for having me. Here is my business card.
lines.id: Selamat siang, Pak Adi. Terima kasih sudah menerima saya. Ini kartu nama saya.

lines.en: Thank you. Did you have a good trip? Please have a seat. Would you like some tea or coffee?
lines.id: Terima kasih. Apakah perjalanan Anda menyenangkan? Silakan duduk. Mau teh atau kopi?

lines.en: Tea, please. The trip was fine, thank you.
lines.id: Teh, tolong. Perjalanannya lancar, terima kasih.

lesson.title: Tips small talk
lesson.text: Ajukan **pertanyaan terbuka** ([[How was ...?]], [[What do you think about ...?]]), dengarkan jawabannya, lalu tanggapi dengan [[Really?]], [[That sounds great.]], atau [[Me too.]] Gunakan **nama lawan bicara** agar terasa hangat.

items: Perkenalan: [[I work as ...]], [[I work in the ... department]], [[I'm responsible for ...]].
Small talk: cuaca, perjalanan, akhir pekan; hindari gaji, politik, dan masalah pribadi.
Mengakhiri: [[It was nice talking to you.]] / [[I'm afraid I have to go.]]
Pilih bahasa **formal** untuk atasan dan tamu, **santai** untuk rekan akrab.
